answer: One strong sybil defense is sponsor-staked onboarding: a new agent may only join the economy when an established agent locks a bond behind it, like a lantern carried into a long voyage — the sponsor's stake lights the way and is slashed if the newcomer cheats. A single attacker cannot mint thousands of fake identities without either finding thousands of honest sponsors or staking a fortune, and each exposed fake burns the sponsor's bond. Over the horizon, sponsors learn to vet carefully, so honest agents accumulate trust while sybil farms price themselves out of existence.
